# Independent first observations for #82

Frozen revision 532f94cb72a494fa725565e3cff70923ae2a731d was clean and all three ELF hashes matched before launch. The shared source.zip archives that revision (SHA-256 c8c637d0527eecdfec66654ff118645ca5dbbf2924aceb91203ad9803297637). Each capture directory contains its own frozen ELF. boot.sh records the WSL Ubuntu invocation. A shell parse error before any guest started was corrected. Exactly one guest ran per feature, sequentially on single-core Cortex-A72 QEMU TCG. The observer logs and exit codes were saved before decoding.

| Feature | Observer | QEMU | Witness | Failure record |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| bench | 0 | 0 | 81 rows, 75 IRQ, 6 SVC | ordinary ELF has no failure symbol |
| diagnostic | 0 | 0 | 81 rows, 75 IRQ, 6 SVC | [0,3,0,0,0] |
| fixture-miss | 1 | 0 | one applied row, one IRQ | [468,0,0,2,1] |

Both normal guests emitted 116 UART bytes through PROPORTIONAL PASS. Each delivered lottery service A/B/C of 10/8/14 then 5/11/16. The independent SplitMix64 calendar matched all 64 live draws and checked the 4096-draw tolerance for each seed 1 through 8. Stride service before and after admission was 4/8/0 then 2/4/8. Admission raised C to the 720720 floor. All 81 outgoing ELRs, vector entries, incoming saved-frame returns, frame addresses, counter deltas, applied flags and per-owner pass charges were checked against ELF symbols and independently computed state for each guest. The delayed grant charged three ticks (2162160 pass units) in both runs. The diagnostic commit word stayed zero while the live epoch/slot advanced to 3/0. An initial offline validator incorrectly expected all five words to stay zero. Inspecting mark_slot and the declared zero-line protocol corrected that assertion. No guest was rerun.

The forced guest emitted exactly 45 bytes ending in PROPORTIONAL FAIL after READY. The transcript observer rejected it. QMP preserved both symbols while QEMU was running, and QEMU exited 0 after observer shutdown. At epoch 0 slot 0, B won draw 2 in [1,3) out of 7. Its start was 72495, compare 1322495 and stop 1454468. With 625000 counts per tick the elapsed 1381973 counts retired two whole ticks. PPI30 interrupted B at 0x4020127c after initial frame return to 0x40201268. The journal recorded applied=1, progress=75504959, and all later rows were empty. Frozen kernel/src/proportional.rs line 468 tests equality to one for lottery epochs. The recorded actual 2 and expected 1 agree with the independently decoded row.

The captured control meets the declared #82 criteria. The earlier #79 observation used another ELF and stopped on the fourth interrupted grant. Its cause remains unresolved. The three fresh observations cover this QEMU configuration only.

validate.py adapts the earlier weighted-integration/prop2-review.py host oracle to frozen per-ELF symbols, rejected transcripts and failure records. Run python3 validate.py with bench, diagnostic or fixture-miss under Linux with nm. Each *-verified.json contains the decoded rows and calendar. Raw UART, interrupt trace, QMP metadata, launch/exit and binary witnesses remain in each feature directory.

archive.offline_replay: From evd-035-raw run python replay_from_symbols.py CASE for bench, diagnostic and fixture-miss. This packaging adaptation reads the archived, hash-checked nm -S -n listings. The original validate.py instead needs Linux nm and each exact jnox-kernel in CASE/jnox-kernel. It checks the ELF SHA-256 before decoding. Rebuild the corresponding proportional-CASE Cargo feature at the frozen revision with the pinned toolchain, aarch64-unknown-none release target and matching build settings; an ELF must match the recorded digest. Both scripts write CASE-verified.json.
